name: ButtonLink
description: A button-styled link with native navigation and open-in-new-tab behaviour.
signature: ({ variant, size, icon, iconEnd, block, render, className, children, ...rest }: ButtonLinkProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: render
props.description: Router-owned anchor. Routing props, styles, ref and event handlers are preserved.

props.name: size
props.description: Shared control height and insets. Default: md.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
